title: Classification of Indian Highways
subject: Geography
description: A classification diagram detailing the different types of highways in India, including National Highways, State Highways, Expressways, and Ring & Bypass Roads, with their administrative bodies, lengths, and key characteristics.
mermaidCode: graph TD A[Classification of Indian Highways] --> B(National Highways - NH) B --> B1[Centrally Administered (MoRTH)] B --> B2[~150,000 km] B --> B3(Longest: NH-44 Srinagar to Kanyakumari) A --> C(State Highways - SH) C --> C1[Managed by State Governments] C --> C2[~100,000 km] C --> C3[Links District HQs, Towns, NHs] A --> D(Expressways) D --> D1[Access-Controlled, High-Speed] D --> D2[Design Speed: 100-160 km/h] D --> D3[Projects: Bharatmala Pariyojana, Golden Quadrilateral] A --> E(Ring & Bypass Roads) E --> E1[De-congest Urban Cores] E --> E2(e.g., Delhi Ring Road, Kolkata Bypass)
